_doc: Garsoore contracted shipping rate cards. This file is the ONLY place a customer-facing shipping price may come from.
STATUS IS LOAD-BEARING. 'contracted' means a signed agreement exists with a logistics provider and the numbers below
are the numbers in that agreement. 'draft' means Garsoore has NOT signed anything yet and these are internal planning
figures. A draft card still prices the shop (the alternative is no shop), but the admin console shows it as unsigned,
because quoting a customer a price you have no contract to honour is exactly the surprise this architecture exists
to prevent. Flip status to 'contracted' and fill providerReference only when a real agreement is in hand.
An order stores the id of the card that priced it. That card's rates are then honoured for that order for its whole
life, even after the card expires or is superseded. Rate changes affect the NEXT card, never a sold order.
Tiers are read as: the rate for the highest 'from' that the chargeable quantity reaches.
All money is USD. All weights are kg, all volumes CBM, all dimensions cm.

cards.notes: Divisor 6000 is the IATA default and MUST be replaced with the contracted divisor on signature — a provider using 5000 raises the cost of every bulky item by 20%.
weightCapPerCbm guards the revenue-tonne rule: cargo denser than this is charged on weight/1000 as CBM-equivalent, which is what every LCL contract does.

_doc: Packed density (kg per CBM) per category, used to ESTIMATE cartoned volume when a product's real packed
dimensions are not yet known. Every one of the 421 catalogue rows has a weight; none has measured dimensions.
This is the declared bridge, and it is marked as an estimate everywhere it is used.
Air break-even at divisor 6000 is 167 kg/CBM: anything below that is volumetric-dominant and costs more to fly
than its weight suggests. The estimate is deliberately conservative (dense items are not over-estimated) so the
engine does not under-quote and hand the customer a surprise later. Garsoore absorbs the difference when the
facility weighs and measures the real carton; the customer's locked price does not move.
